description: Approved differences between gtfs.guru and MobilityData/gtfs-validator on the mdb-50 catalogue set (scripts/real_world/mdb50.json), in the same format as expected_deltas.json. mdb_parity.py compare loads expected_deltas.json first, so feeds shared with the 12-feed corpus (currently mdb-502) are approved there and not repeated here. Totals are pinned: a difference that changes size loses its approval and resurfaces.

entries.reason: Triaged 2026-09-15 (canon parity). The one pair Java reports and gtfs.guru does not is trip 3467, stops 11797 and 4090 on shape 952: both stops match the same shape vertex (13.758416, 100.616676), so their positions along the shape differ only by the rounding of one segment length (haversine on the vertex against the S2Point angle to the match). The matcher is now an operation-for-operation port of S2EdgeUtil.getClosestPoint and S2LatLng.getDistance, but that last rounding comes from sin/cos/asin/atan2 themselves, which are HotSpot's fdlibm on the JVM and Apple's libm here and differ in the last ulp. Every other shape-matching notice on this feed (63 stop_has_too_many_matches_for_shape, the other 71 out-of-order pairs) agrees. Kept as a known ulp-level difference.
